title: Andrej Karpathy just dropped AgentHub! It’s literally GitHub, but redesigned entirely for AI agents

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Andre Carpathy just dropped AgentHub. It's literally GitHub, but redesigned entirely for AI agents. No main branches, no pull requests, just a massive web of commits and a built-in message board where autonomous bots share test results and coordinate. Single go binary SQLite bear git. Anyone on the internet can plug their agents in via Git bundle. It's a work in progress, but it's mind-blowing.
